proofStanding: replayed_upper_bound for successful witnesses; UNKNOWN for bounded misses; heuristic_observation for panel generalization

definitions.minimumMovesUpperBound: fewest moves among successful registered bounded-search witnesses
definitions.budgetTightnessUpperBound: minimumMovesUpperBound divided by the allowed moves
definitions.chainLengthDependenceUpperBound: smallest tested chain cap with a successful registered witness

P1.required: at least 7/8 rows and all four profiles

P2.required: at least six pairs, 75% bin agreement, and no worsened upper bound

P3.note: diagnostic only; the arms are not compute matched
